title: 白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈
summary: 白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
summaryEn: Snøhvit Hammerfest is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on Arctic subsea gathering, onshore liquefaction and carbon-dioxide separation, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流
v31FocusEn: Arctic subsea gathering, onshore liquefaction and carbon-dioxide separation

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Snøhvit Hammerfest
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸」與「壓縮功與級間冷卻：北極海底集輸」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Decline and delivery commitments — case 1" and "Compression work and intercooling — case 2": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Decline and delivery commitments — case 1" is correct?
options: 把一個氣源的簡化指數衰減曲線與下游固定需求分開建模，才不會把某天的峰值流量誤當成全年能力。

optionsEn: Model a gas source with a simple exponential decline curve separately from fixed downstream demand, rather than treating a daily peak as annual capability.
The first day of output can simply be multiplied by the entire development lifetime.
Doubling pressure always doubles compression work exactly.

quiz.explanationEn: Model a gas source with a simple exponential decline curve separately from fixed downstream demand, rather than treating a daily peak as annual capability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Decline and delivery commitments — case 1: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸」如何決定「白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Decline and delivery commitments — case 1” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Snøhvit Hammerfest”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本工程研究問題是「北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流」。以白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈作為地理與系統脈絡，本單元建立可驗證的教學假設；下列模型並非宣稱該場址採用相同設備尺寸、工況或流程。把一個氣源的簡化指數衰減曲線與下游固定需求分開建模，才不會把某天的峰值流量誤當成全年能力。衰減常數在此只是教學參數，實際儲集層可能受壓力、含水與壓縮設備共同控制；作圖時須同時保留原始樣本、時間單位及模型殘差。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case question is Arctic subsea gathering, onshore liquefaction and carbon-dioxide separation. Using Snøhvit Hammerfest as geographic and system context, this unit constructs a testable teaching scenario; it does not assert that the site has the same dimensions, conditions or flowsheet as the model. Model a gas source with a simple exponential decline curve separately from fixed downstream demand, rather than treating a daily peak as annual capability. The decline constant here is a teaching parameter; actual reservoir delivery also depends on pressure, water and compression. Keep raw observations, time units and residuals alongside the plotted curve. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。

The study focuses on Arctic subsea gathering, onshore liquefaction and carbon-dioxide separation, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The first day of output can simply be multiplied by the entire development lifetime." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.question: 依「供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸」的模型 q(t)=q0·exp(−D·t)，教學假設，非場址設計值：假設氣源在指定年數後的流量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model q(t)=q0·exp(−D·t) for "Decline and delivery commitments — case 1", which value is closest to the teaching assumption, not site design data: hypothetical source flow after the specified years?
options: 4.02 million Sm³/d
8.04 million Sm³/d
80.4 million Sm³/d
optionsEn: 4.02 million Sm³/d
8.04 million Sm³/d
80.4 million Sm³/d
quiz.explanation: q(t)=q0·exp(−D·t)；代入 q0 = 12 million Sm³/d、D = 0.08 1/year、t = 5 year，得 8.04 million Sm³/d（教學假設，非場址設計值：假設氣源在指定年數後的流量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: q(t)=q0·exp(−D·t); with q0 = 12 million Sm³/d, D = 0.08 1/year, t = 5 year the result is 8.04 million Sm³/d (teaching assumption, not site design data: hypothetical source flow after the specified years). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Decline and delivery commitments — case 1: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Decline and delivery commitments — case 1” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：q(t)=q0·exp(−D·t)；代入 q0 = 12 million Sm³/d、D = 0.08 1/year、t = 5 year，得 8.04 million Sm³/d（教學假設，非場址設計值：假設氣源在指定年數後的流量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 D 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: q(t)=q0·exp(−D·t); with q0 = 12 million Sm³/d, D = 0.08 1/year, t = 5 year the result is 8.04 million Sm³/d (teaching assumption, not site design data: hypothetical source flow after the specified years). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise D by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.73 million Sm³/d（-3.9%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 7.73 million Sm³/d (-3.9%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 8.04 million Sm³/d（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 D 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 8.04 million Sm³/d (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in D with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: q(t)=q0·exp(−D·t)；代入 q0 = 12 million Sm³/d、D = 0.08 1/year、t = 5 year，得 8.04 million Sm³/d（教學假設，非場址設計值：假設氣源在指定年數後的流量）。
knowledge.textEn: q(t)=q0·exp(−D·t); with q0 = 12 million Sm³/d, D = 0.08 1/year, t = 5 year the result is 8.04 million Sm³/d (teaching assumption, not site design data: hypothetical source flow after the specified years).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: D 增加 10% 時，結果變為 7.73 million Sm³/d（-3.9%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising D by 10% changes the result to 7.73 million Sm³/d (-3.9%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為明示的合成教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are explicit synthetic teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Decline and delivery commitments — case 1"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For Arctic subsea gathering, onshore liquefaction and carbon-dioxide separation, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data.
quiz.explanation: 針對北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For Arctic subsea gathering, onshore liquefaction and carbon-dioxide separation, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Decline and delivery commitments — case 1: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Decline and delivery commitments — case 1” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。用合成月資料擬合衰減常數，保留末六個月作外部驗證；分別畫出預測值、殘差與供應缺口，檢查季節性是否被錯誤吸收到衰減率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For Arctic subsea gathering, onshore liquefaction and carbon-dioxide separation, first list the site data needed but not supplied by the public source, then validate synthetic data. Fit the decline constant to synthetic monthly data and reserve the final six months for validation. Plot predictions, residuals and delivery deficits separately, checking that seasonality has not been absorbed into the decline rate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交付圖附上氣源與設備可用度兩層假設，並保存擬合區間及未使用的驗證資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Attach separate source and equipment-availability assumptions to the delivery graph and retain the fitting interval and unused validation data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若壓縮機停機造成的短期缺量被當成地質衰減，模型會低估可恢復產能；若只用高流量期間擬合，則會高估長期交付能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A compressor outage mistaken for geological decline understates recoverable delivery, while fitting only high-flow periods overstates long-term supply capability. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 針對北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流，先寫出本單元需要但公開來源未提供的現場資料，再進行合成資料驗證。用合成月資料擬合衰減常數，保留末六個月作外部驗證；分別畫出預測值、殘差與供應缺口，檢查季節性是否被錯誤吸收到衰減率。

Fit the decline constant to synthetic monthly data and reserve the final six months for validation. Plot predictions, residuals and delivery deficits separately, checking that seasonality has not been absorbed into the decline rate.

quiz.question: 在「供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Decline and delivery commitments — case 1" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若壓縮機停機造成的短期缺量被當成地質衰減，模型會低估可恢復產能；若只用高流量期間擬合，則會高估長期交付能力。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
壓力加倍時，壓縮功一定正好加倍。
optionsEn: A compressor outage mistaken for geological decline understates recoverable delivery, while fitting only high-flow periods overstates long-term supply capability.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Doubling pressure always doubles compression work exactly.
quiz.explanation: 若壓縮機停機造成的短期缺量被當成地質衰減，模型會低估可恢復產能；若只用高流量期間擬合，則會高估長期交付能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A compressor outage mistaken for geological decline understates recoverable delivery, while fitting only high-flow periods overstates long-term supply capability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 供氣衰減與承諾量：北極海底集輸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Decline and delivery commitments — case 1: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 若壓縮機停機造成的短期缺量被當成地質衰減，模型會低估可恢復產能；若只用高流量期間擬合，則會高估長期交付能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: A compressor outage mistaken for geological decline understates recoverable delivery, while fitting only high-flow periods overstates long-term supply capability. Compare downtime flags and pressure histories before interpreting the fitted trend. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compression work and intercooling — case 2” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Snøhvit Hammerfest”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本工程研究問題是「北極海底集輸、岸上液化與二氧化碳分流」。以白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈作為地理與系統脈絡，本單元建立可驗證的教學假設；下列模型並非宣稱該場址採用相同設備尺寸、工況或流程。以理想氣體等熵功作為比較基準，將壓力比、入口絕對溫度與效率分開。此模型不含真實氣體狀態方程或完整機組曲線，只用來比較增加壓力比為何會增加軸功，以及冷卻入口氣體為何能降低後段功率；所有壓力比都使用絕對壓力。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case question is Arctic subsea gathering, onshore liquefaction and carbon-dioxide separation. Using Snøhvit Hammerfest as geographic and system context, this unit constructs a testable teaching scenario; it does not assert that the site has the same dimensions, conditions or flowsheet as the model. Use ideal-gas isentropic work as a comparison baseline, separating pressure ratio, absolute inlet temperature and efficiency. This is not a real-gas equation of state or a complete machine map: it compares why larger pressure ratio increases shaft work and why cooling the inlet reduces subsequent work. Form ratios from absolute pressures. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 壓縮功與級間冷卻：北極海底集輸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compression work and intercooling — case 2: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓縮功與級間冷卻：北極海底集輸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Compression work and intercooling — case 2” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 入口溫度升高與效率下降都會增加耗電，單看電流無法辨別原因；需要同時比較流量、壓比與入口狀態，才不會把環境變化誤診為機械劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「白雪氣田與哈默弗斯特液化鏈」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: Both hotter inlet gas and lower efficiency increase electrical demand, so current alone cannot identify the cause. Compare flow, pressure ratio and inlet state together before interpreting ambient variation as machine deterioration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Snøhvit Hammerfest”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此模型不含真實氣體狀態方程或完整機組曲線，只用來比較增加壓力比為何會增加軸功，以及冷卻入口氣體為何能降低後段功率；所有壓力比都使用絕對壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Form ratios from absolute pressures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓力加倍時，壓縮功一定正好加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling pressure always doubles compression work exactly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 入口溫度升高與效率下降都會增加耗電，單看電流無法辨別原因；需要同時比較流量、壓比與入口狀態，才不會把環境變化誤診為機械劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Both hotter inlet gas and lower efficiency increase electrical demand, so current alone cannot identify the cause. Compare flow, pressure ratio and inlet state together before interpreting ambient variation as machine deterioration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
